description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Home' for the ApplicantPortal project. It renders the main homepage content, including hero section, features, and about section, along with some custom hooks for scroll-based fade-in effects.

methods.name: useFadeInOnScroll
methods.description: A custom React hook that adds a 'fade-in--visible' class to a DOM element when it scrolls into view with an optional delay.
